mapper.sql: select t.tag_id, t.library_id, t.dir_id, t.field_name, t.tag_name, t.data_type, t.tag_type, t.is_object_key, t.business_caliber, t.tech_caliber, t.valid_period, t.update_cycle, t.create_way, t.status, t.version, t.source_version_id, t.source_snapshot, t.source_fingerprint, t.confirmed_fingerprint, t.source_status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, l.library_name from tl_tag t left join tl_tag_library l on l.library_id = t.library_id
mapper.select: where t.library_id = #{libraryId} and t.field_name = #{fieldName} and t.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into tl_tag ( library_id, dir_id, field_name, tag_name, data_type, tag_type, is_object_key, business_caliber, tech_caliber, valid_period, update_cycle, create_way, status, version, source_version_id, source_snapshot, source_fingerprint, confirmed_fingerprint, source_status, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{libraryId}, #{dirId}, #{fieldName}, #{tagName}, #{dataType}, #{tagType}, #{isObjectKey}, #{businessCaliber}, #{techCaliber}, #{validPeriod}, #{updateCycle}, #{createWay}, #{status}, #{version}, #{sourceVersionId}, #{sourceSnapshot}, #{sourceFingerprint}, #{confirmedFingerprint}, #{sourceStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )

insert into tl_tag ( library_id, dir_id, field_name, tag_name, data_type, tag_type, is_object_key, business_caliber, tech_caliber, valid_period, update_cycle, create_way, status, version, source_version_id, source_snapshot, source_fingerprint, confirmed_fingerprint, source_status, create_by, create_time, remark ) values
( #{tag.libraryId}, #{tag.dirId}, #{tag.fieldName}, #{tag.tagName}, #{tag.dataType}, #{tag.tagType}, #{tag.isObjectKey}, #{tag.businessCaliber}, #{tag.techCaliber}, #{tag.validPeriod}, #{tag.updateCycle}, #{tag.createWay}, #{tag.status}, #{tag.version}, #{tag.sourceVersionId}, #{tag.sourceSnapshot}, #{tag.sourceFingerprint}, #{tag.confirmedFingerprint}, #{tag.sourceStatus}, #{tag.createBy}, sysdate(), #{tag.remark} )
mapper.update: update tl_tag set source_version_id = #{sourceVersionId}, source_snapshot = #{sourceSnapshot}, source_fingerprint = #{sourceFingerprint}, source_status = #{sourceStatus}, is_object_key = #{isObjectKey}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where tag_id = #{tagId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from tl_tag where library_id = #{libraryId} and status = '2' and del_flag = '0'

select t.tag_id, t.library_id, t.dir_id, t.field_name, t.tag_name, t.data_type, t.tag_type, t.is_object_key, t.business_caliber, t.tech_caliber, t.valid_period, t.update_cycle, t.create_way, t.status, t.version, t.source_version_id, t.source_snapshot, t.source_fingerprint, t.confirmed_fingerprint, t.source_status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark from tl_tag t where t.tag_id = #{tagId} and t.del_flag = '0' for update
mapper.update: update tl_tag set tag_name = #{tagName}, tag_type = #{tagType}, dir_id = #{dirId}, tech_caliber = #{techCaliber}, business_caliber = #{businessCaliber}, version = #{version}, status = #{status}, confirmed_fingerprint = #{confirmedFingerprint}, source_status = #{sourceStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where tag_id = #{tagId}
